summary: Nora can now keep notes — titled, durable records of open questions she carries between conversations. Every turn shows her the index of what is still open in that workspace; she reads a note's contents on demand, and can create or revise one.
details: The index shows title and a one-line description only. Reading a note's contents costs a tool call, and revising one requires having read it first.
Notes are scoped to a WORKSPACE, not a room: a note raised in the group never appears in the operator's own rooms, and vice versa.
A revision appends rather than overwrites, so nothing she writes destroys what was there.
limitations: No curator yet: nothing merges duplicate notes, retires one whose date has passed, or promotes a settled note to an event. That is a Dreamer adaptor and the runtime it needs is not built, so the notebook only grows for now.
She creates notes when asked or when she judges it worthwhile in the turn; she does not yet notice an open question on her own after the conversation has moved on.
